name: MuJS
baseline: goja (Go JavaScript interpreter); also Boa (Rust) and Jint (.NET) JavaScript interpreters in the same table
workload: V8 v7 benchmark suite (Richards, DeltaBlue, Crypto, RayTrace, EarleyBoyer, RegExp, Splay, NavierStokes) run through each engine's CLI on GitHub Actions runners; overall Score, higher is better.
claimed_speedup: Overall Score, ubuntu run: MuJS 435 vs goja 365, Boa 279, Jint 246 (about 1.19x, 1.56x and 1.77x, derived from page data). macos-arm64 run: MuJS 522 vs goja 358, Boa 302, Jint 239. windows run: MuJS 339 vs goja 229, Jint 159 (Boa has no score there). MuJS also scores above es5 (305), quickjs-oxide (303), xst (315) and ringo (372) on ubuntu.
compiler_and_flags: MuJS built by ahaoboy/mujs-build with 'make release HAVE_READLINE=no' from the Codeberg HEAD (daily cron); runner default compiler and the Makefile release flags are not stated on any page opened.
hardware: GitHub Actions hosted runners (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest arm64, windows-latest); CPU model not stated.
stars_or_usage: 858 stars on the GitHub mirror (repo migrated to Codeberg)
tradeoffs: Interpreter only, built for embedding. Very small: total size 378.8K on the ubuntu run, giving the benchmark's Score/MB of 1175. It is not the fastest embeddable engine: in the same table QuickJS scores 1522 and Duktape 682 on ubuntu, and Duktape 842 vs MuJS 522 on macos-arm64.
caveats: Nobody at the MuJS project claims this win; it is read off an automated third-party leaderboard (ahaoboy/js-engine-benchmark, 59 stars, regenerated daily, page generated 10/11/2026), so tier C rather than B because the suite is small and not well known, and CPU model, compiler and flags are missing. Runs happen on shared CI runners, so noise is likely, and the managed-runtime baselines (goja, Boa, Jint) are driven through wrapper CLIs, so host and startup overhead may be counted. The winning baselines are the weaker engines in the table; MuJS loses to QuickJS, Duktape, Hermes and others, and JerryScript has no score. The README table has more per-benchmark values than engines in some rows, so only the Score row was used, cross-checked against the engine table above it. The GitHub repo is a stub (README: 'This repository has migrated to https://codeberg.org/ccxvii/mujs'); the canonical Codeberg repo could not be opened from this environment (egress blocked), so last_commit is the last commit on the GitHub mirror and the orchestrator may want a repo_url override to the Codeberg URL.
